title: Squid with peas and lemon
summary: Squid with peas and lemon is a british dinner built around squid rings and frozen peas, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Squid with peas and lemon chopped before the pan goes on. Pat squid rings dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook squid rings until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook frozen peas and garlic until hot and lightly browned. Return squid rings and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Squid with peas and lemon, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Squid with peas and lemon before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
